note: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). Private reference only. Each feature: delta-encoded integer metres in the en frame about lat 51.309, lon -0.253; first pair absolute; simplified to about 3 m (closed rings stay closed). Paths only within 300 m of the course, buildings within 350 m; building: flat list of [centre x, centre y, radius] (a circle of the same area). Roads only within 500 m of the course; golf: only areas over 3000 m2 (the course and its fairways, no greens or tees).
